newsitem.title: USA: Dow Industrials dip at open, data burdens market.
newsitem.headline: Dow Industrials dip at open, data burdens market.

text.p: The Dow Jones industrial average slipped at the market open on Thursday, after April inflation data proved mildly disappointing and sent bonds trending lower.
The Dow was trading off about 19 points at 7266.

The core Consumer Price Index came in slightly above expectations, up 0.3 percent versus a forecast gain of 0.2 percent. Industrial production in April was unchanged from March, versus an expected rise of 0.2 percent.
The long bond was trading off 14/32 at 6.92 percent compared with Wednesday's closing yield of 6.89 percent.
